description:
🔴 **The evidence rule is enforced at the one moment the agent can no longer act on it.** `measure_gate` runs at `driver.sh:2011` — commented "EVERY path to a merge" — and nowhere else. So an agent marks a story `passes: true` with empty `notes`, keeps going, finishes every story, and only when the run reaches MERGE is anything said. By then the agent is gone, the run is over, and a human has to open the branch, re-run the gate and type the number in.

**Measured 2026-08-17: this happened FOUR times in one day, across THREE repos.** cuneiform `352` (4 stories, all `passes: true`, all `notes` empty — US-3 flagged), chief-cloud `143` (2 stories, both empty), chief-cloud `80` (3 stories, all empty), insimul `261` (notes present but holding design reasoning, not a measurement — the guard's own words: "no observed value in it"). Every one had to be rescued by hand. Not one was a defect in the WORK: `143` was 936 insertions and 443 tests passing, `352` was a clean catalog fold, `80` merged untouched once its numbers were recorded.

**The instruction is not the problem and must not be 'fixed' again.** `engine/instructions.md:39` is step 8 — *"Record what you OBSERVED in that story's `notes` field, in the same edit"* — with two worked examples and an explicit warning that chief will demote the story. `_compose_prompt` puts it in the prompt on EVERY turn (`agent.sh:245,248`). All four runs above started after that shipped (instruction 17:42, installed 17:52; runs 17:57, 18:39, 18:42). Agents receive it every turn and do not comply. Telling them harder is the fix that has already been tried.

**What has not been tried is telling them AT THE RIGHT TIME.** `measure.sh:38` says the check "only ever demotes, which makes it safe to run everywhere and useless if it does not" — the author already established it is safe anywhere. And `CHIEF_ITER_HOOK` (`agent.sh:1181`) is an existing seam that runs between iterations, already used for base re-integration. The pieces are on the shelf; nothing wired them together.

Demote at the boundary and the agent finds US-1 back at `passes: false` on its next turn, WHILE it still has the command output in context and can paste the number in one edit. Demote at merge and it costs a whole run plus an operator.

userStories.title: A story marked without evidence is demoted at the iteration boundary, not at merge
acceptanceCriteria: `measure_gate` (or the same predicate) runs at the iteration boundary — the `CHIEF_ITER_HOOK` seam at `agent.sh:1181` is the existing place — so a story marked `passes: true` with no observed value is back at `passes: false` before the next turn begins.
The merge-time check at `driver.sh:2011` STAYS. It is the floor and the boundary check is not a replacement for it; a run whose last iteration marks a story is still caught.

A behavioural test in `test/` drives an agent that marks a story with empty `notes`, and asserts the story reads `passes: false` at the START of the next iteration — not merely that the run eventually fails.

userStories.title: The next turn is TOLD what was demoted and why
acceptanceCriteria: When the boundary demotes a story, the next turn's prompt names it, quotes the bar its criteria state, and says what is missing — the same words `measure.sh` already produces at merge (`states a bar` / `claimed` / `recorded`). A silent demotion reads to the agent as its own edit failing to save, and it will simply re-mark it.
The message names the story id and the bar. Do not make it generic advice; the agent already receives generic advice every turn in `instructions.md` step 8 and it demonstrably does not land.
A test asserts the demotion reason reaches the prompt file the provider is invoked with, not just the log.

userStories.title: The loop cannot be spent re-marking the same story
acceptanceCriteria: A story demoted at the boundary and re-marked with evidence counts as PROGRESS, so the run does not read it as a stall.

A story demoted twice in a row for the same reason does NOT loop indefinitely — it is either escalated or the run stops with the demotion named. An agent that cannot produce a number for a bar will otherwise burn its whole budget rediscovering that.
A test drives the re-mark path and asserts both: the good case advances, and the pathological case terminates rather than spinning.
